GitHub user Jokser opened a pull request:

https://github.com/apache/ignite/pull/3880

IGNITE-8324 Update discovery cache as well as topology version

You can merge this pull request into a Git repository by running:

$ git pull https://github.com/gridgain/apache-ignite ignite-8324

Alternatively you can review and apply these changes as the patch at:

https://github.com/apache/ignite/pull/3880.patch

To close this pull request, make a commit to your master/trunk branch
with (at least) the following in the commit message:

This closes #3880

commit df540e065c344444ea80fe6c6e874521cd130879
Author: Pavel Kovalenko <jokserfn@...>
Date: 2018-04-19T15:12:06Z

IGNITE-8324 Update discovery caches as well as topology version. Remove unnecessary `updateTopologies` calls.

agoncharuk Ready to review.
Resolution:
Instead of updating discoCache through "initTopologies" in several places we update discoCache as well as topology version is updated (inside GridDhtTopology). This significantly simplifies overall behaviour and keeps state of topology discoCache consistent on all nodes during exchange merges. Additional check on that has added to CacheExchangeMergeTest suite tests.
Branch: ignite-8324
Public TC: https://ci.ignite.apache.org/project.html?projectId=IgniteTests24Java8&branch_IgniteTests24Java8=pull%2F3880%2Fhead

Jokser, even though the fix looks elegant, I think it loses a piece of functionality which is contained in updateTopologies(boolean) method: we call exchange().clearClientTopology(grp.groupId()), which removes the client topology from client topologies map and runs update on another topology. Can you please add an assert which checks that on merged exchange there are no client topologies that should be moved to regular topology?
I got why these calls are not needed, will merge the fix shortly.

Github user asfgit closed the pull request at:

https://github.com/apache/ignite/pull/3880
